verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q (Corrosive Charge) poke before level 3 and let him chip you down from range; you win if you land E (Test of Spirit) whenever his E (Disdain) is on cooldown and force the spirit trade.

brief.thesis: Illaoi holds lane and solo-kill advantage here even though the raw win rate sits near 49.7% over 720 games, because her E (Test of Spirit) punishes any Urgot who stands still to poke, while Urgot's only answer is to disengage with Disdain or out-range her with Corrosive Charge. Whoever controls when Illaoi's spirit lands dictates the lane.

theirWindow.when: Q (Corrosive Charge) is up and you're pushed up
theirWindow.what: He fires it at your feet from 800 range to slow and chip you before you can close distance. Don't hold forward position just to last-hit while this is up; step off the wave instead.

yourWindow.what: With no dash to disengage, land E (Test of Spirit) and commit. He has to either tank the echoed damage in melee or run on foot, and either choice loses him the trade.

start.why: Highest-winning start in this matchup (51.2% over 492 games, 53.8% pick) — the extra AD and sustain let you trade through Q poke instead of backing off every time he fires it.

boots.why: 76.4% pick rate here, and the flat damage reduction specifically blunts his auto-attacks and Echoing Flames procs, which are both physical.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (52.1% over 119 games) — the armor shred matters since Urgot's whole kit is physical.
Adds the slow-on-cast and shield so you stop getting kited by Corrosive Charge after you've closed distance.
The HP and tenacity buy you the extra survivability you need to live through his R execute threshold.

he's snowballed and you need to survive into his R execute window
you want more lane sustain and burst off your W engage

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-winning page here (52%, 40.8% pick) — the per-proc healing offsets the chip damage from Q (Corrosive Charge) across a long poke-heavy laning phase.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash runs at 51.4% win rate here and directly answers the two things that kill you in this lane: it softens Corrosive Charge burst and takes the edge off his R execute threshold when you're caught low.

playing.title: Lane near terrain
playing.detail: Illaoi's passive Tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so fighting next to walls gives you extra Tentacle swings and Q (Tentacle Smash) value he can't contest.

playing.title: Throw E on cooldown
playing.detail: Whenever Test of Spirit (16-12s cooldown) is up, use it. If he runs, he becomes a Vessel spawning Tentacles that zone and chip him for free.

playing.title: Don't facetank Q pre-6
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge (10-8s cooldown, 800 range) slows and chips from range. Before level 3 especially, step off the wave rather than eating it to last-hit.

playing.title: All-in once R is up
playing.detail: Leap of Faith (120-70s cooldown) hits everyone nearby and spawns a Tentacle per champion hit — look to commit fully to fights from level 6 on.

playing.title: Punish missing Disdain
playing.detail: When his E (16-14s cooldown) is down, he has no dash to escape or interrupt you. This is your best window to land W (Harsh Lesson) into E and force the full trade.

playing.title: Respect the execute
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death (100-70s cooldown, 2500 range) executes below a health threshold. Don't stay in lane at low HP past level 6 just to contest CS.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoners above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning — when to throw E, when to respect Q, when his E being down means commit — is my own read of the ability text, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful not to be harassed by Urgot’s (Q) too often. As Urgot’s (P) deals a lot of damage, we recommend fighting next to terrain. Try to be careful before you reach level 3, but keep in mind that Illaoi will not fall behind if Urgot closes in with (E) post-level 3. Although we recommend actively engaging after reaching level 6, be careful to be killed with (R) when your health is low.
